description: This PHP file defines an abstract controller class for REST API endpoints within the OrangeHRM system. It provides a common structure for handling HTTP requests (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE), validation, and exception management for REST API controllers in the V2 namespace of the core module.

classes.name: AbstractRestController
classes.description: An abstract class providing a template for RESTful API endpoints, including request handling, validation, error handling, and response formatting.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initialize the request. Intended to be overridden in subclasses.

methods.name: handleGetRequest
methods.description: Abstract method to handle GET requests.

methods.name: handlePostRequest
methods.description: Abstract method to handle POST requests.

methods.name: handlePutRequest
methods.description: Abstract method to handle PUT requests.

methods.name: handleDeleteRequest
methods.description: Abstract method to handle DELETE requests.

methods.name: initGetValidationRule
methods.description: Abstract method for initializing validation rules for GET requests.

methods.name: initPostValidationRule
methods.description: Abstract method for initializing validation rules for POST requests.

methods.name: initPutValidationRule
methods.description: Abstract method for initializing validation rules for PUT requests.

methods.name: initDeleteValidationRule
methods.description: Abstract method for initializing validation rules for DELETE requests.

methods.name: getValidationRule
methods.description: Selects appropriate validation rules based on HTTP method.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Main method to process an HttpRequest, handle different HTTP methods, perform validation, execute request handling, and manage exceptions, returning an HttpResponse.
